paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Tehillim, chapter 78, at the additional printed locator 17, reporting in the name of R' Yose ben Ketzarta. See the entry R' Chanan, father of R' Shimon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פע״ח-יז gives 78 plus 17, without deciding verse versus section or checking a modern edition. Ketzarta is approximate transliteration; Amora is explicit classification, not title evidence.

אבוה ד־ plainly means father-of in the cross-reference label. It is Hyman’s label, not a newly verified genealogy or authority link; no false linguistic uncertainty is needed. All four personal-title abbreviations remain R'.
